sloka: ततः पाशुपतं दिव्यमस्त्रं सन्धाय कार्मुके ।तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति तानुक्त्वा तच्चापं विचकर्ष स ।। ७.२१.४१ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ pāśupataṁ divyamastraṁ sandhāya kārmuke ।tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti tānuktvā taccāpaṁ vicakarṣa sa ।। 7.21.41 ॥

translations.english: Then, he fixed the divine Pāśupata weapon on his bow, and having told them "Stop! Stop!", he drew that bow.
